transcript.content: Thanks for calling Chairside Dental! How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning.
Sure! Can I get your full name, and are you a new or existing patient?
Jane Doe, I'm a new patient. My insurance is Delta Dental.
Great, and what day works best for your cleaning?
Next Monday, September 22nd, in the afternoon if possible.
I have 2:00 PM on Monday, September 22nd available -- does that work?
You're all set for 2:00 PM on September 22nd. You'll get a text confirmation shortly.
